Three steps to get going

1

Install the program (at the Windows warning: “More info”, then “Run anyway”).

2

Create a new project and enter the room sizes: width, depth and ceiling height.

3

Add the first base cabinet from the catalog and open “Cut sizes”. That is your first cut list.
